title: Hilbert-Pólya Conjecture
exact_target: Can the nontrivial zeta zeros be realized, with their multiplicities, by the real eigenvalues of a self-adjoint operator after shifting by one-half and multiplying by the imaginary unit?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1275 (NT-068). CC BY 4.0.

Sebastian Endres and Frank Steiner, \emph{The Berry--Keating operator on $L^2(\mathbb R_{>},dx)$ and on compact quantum graphs with general self-adjoint realizations}, arXiv:0912.3183v5 (2011), Section 1, pp. 2--3.
